instructions: In this research study, you will see pictures of different objects.

The images will be blurry and hard to see at first.

Later on, you'll get to see the clear versions.

After each picture, you will provide your best guess for the name of the main object in the photo.

Name the main object, not things in the background. Short, single word responses are ok, and spelling errors do not matter.
Do your best to come up with an accurate guess. If you really are not sure, you can leave your response blank. There is no penalty for being wrong.

You will then rate your confidence that your guess was the correct label (0% to 100% certain).

For example, 50% confidence would mean an equal chance of being right or being wrong (like a coin flip).
Next, you will rate how much you want to see the clear image (from "I do not care at all" to "I really want to know!").
Finally, you will get to see the clear version of the picture.
Click Continue to go through an example.

Each trial will be the same.

You will 1) see an image, and 2) guess the object.
You will then 3) rate your confidence, and 4) your interest in seeing the clear image.
The clear image will then be shown.
This concludes the instructions. Click Continue when you are ready to begin.
